T.I really cooked King for only have 12 viewers 😭😭
“Yall coulda did that on FaceTime” 

T.I. couldn’t let his son King slide after noticing only 12 people were watching his livestream 😂

The playful roast was caught in a recent episode of Royal Absurdities, T.I. and Tiny’s family series, which gives viewers a look at their everyday conversations and family moments. King’s viewer count became the punchline, and T.I. made sure he heard about it 😭

Would you keep streaming with 12 people watching? 😅
